MSBuilds, but the .swr file manifest continued to place the x86 version
twice (in bin/ and bin/amd64/). Update it to use the x64 version for the

preemptively changing it now in case that becomes untrue in the future.

b_info.message:
Merge pull request #216 from dsplaisted/xplat

Add support for incrementing build numbers from build machines

o_info.message:
Restore NuGet packages from build.proj

When we moved package restore from build.cmd to build.proj, we stopped
restoring the packages required for "normal" reasons, as opposed to build
tools.

This adds a step that will restore the packages from the entry point
project.

It's unfortunate that nuget doesn't understand traversal projects, which
means restoring packages based on the .sln rather than the list in
build.proj which will actually be built.  We could potentially also
restore **\project.json, but then that would require N calls to nuget.exe.
This seems better for now.

b_info.message:
Make FileMatcher more friendly with forward and backward slashes (#1035)

* FileMatcher refactorings

* Replace properties with characters

On OSX, both of those properties return forward slash

* Update item tests to work with slashes

* FilematcherTests permute through different slashes

* Add Path equality to FileMatcher

To support includes and excludes with slashes and back-slashes

* Fix tests for crossplat IO

- update some tests and test utilities to use Path.Combine
- update test utilities to normalize slashes on assertions
- update GetItemsFromFragmentWithGlobs to reuse test infrastructure

update tests

* Tests for slash preservation

The slashes in the fixed directory part of a filespec containing a wildcard should be preserved. At least that's what the code does. Added unit tests to assert this behaviour

* Remove slash literals

* Replace Path.DirSep and Path.AltDirSep with literals

Fix generated editor config files for xaml precompile (#6438)

The CSC task was not being passing EditorConfig Files when invoked as part of XamlPreCompile. In addition the `GenerateMSBuildEditorConfigFileCore` task needs to have been run to actually generate the required file. Fixes #6323.

b_info.message:
Ensure context is not cached before logging info (#6437)

Fixes #6436 which causes this crash in cases where MSBuild's result
caching is turned on (generally this is for large builds in 32-bit
MSBuild).

Merge pull request #216 from dsplaisted/xplat

Add support for incrementing build numbers from build machines

o_info.message:
Restore NuGet packages from build.proj

When we moved package restore from build.cmd to build.proj, we stopped
restoring the packages required for "normal" reasons, as opposed to build
tools.

This adds a step that will restore the packages from the entry point
project.

It's unfortunate that nuget doesn't understand traversal projects, which
means restoring packages based on the .sln rather than the list in
build.proj which will actually be built.  We could potentially also
restore **\project.json, but then that would require N calls to nuget.exe.
This seems better for now.

b_info.message:
Make static regex compiled (#1199)

To make them run faster (.net blog says 30% faster). The increased Regex
creation time should be shadowed by how many regex calls are made during
evaluation (e.g. for each metadata reference) and execution.

o_info.message:
Locate optimization data in MSBuild subfolder (#1193)

Fixes #1128 by pointing to the subfolder where MSBuild's optimization data
lives in the (internal-only) datastore.

This fix requires the IBCMerge Microbuild plugin 0.3.1 or greater.

o_info.message:
Restore NuGet packages from build.proj

When we moved package restore from build.cmd to build.proj, we stopped
restoring the packages required for "normal" reasons, as opposed to build
tools.

This adds a step that will restore the packages from the entry point
project.

It's unfortunate that nuget doesn't understand traversal projects, which
means restoring packages based on the .sln rather than the list in
build.proj which will actually be built.  We could potentially also
restore **\project.json, but then that would require N calls to nuget.exe.
This seems better for now.

restoring the packages required for "normal" reasons, as opposed to build
tools.

This adds a step that will restore the packages from the entry point
project.

It's unfortunate that nuget doesn't understand traversal projects, which
means restoring packages based on the .sln rather than the list in
build.proj which will actually be built.  We could potentially also
restore **\project.json, but then that would require N calls to nuget.exe.
This seems better for now.

b_info.message:
Merge pull request #216 from dsplaisted/xplat

Add support for incrementing build numbers from build machines

o_info.message:
Restore NuGet packages from build.proj

When we moved package restore from build.cmd to build.proj, we stopped
restoring the packages required for "normal" reasons, as opposed to build
tools.

This adds a step that will restore the packages from the entry point
project.

It's unfortunate that nuget doesn't understand traversal projects, which
means restoring packages based on the .sln rather than the list in
build.proj which will actually be built.  We could potentially also
restore **\project.json, but then that would require N calls to nuget.exe.
This seems better for now.
